title: Ontario AI Map feature
description: One GeoJSON Feature in any of the six data layers. Every property in the data model is required and present; those documented as nullable accept null rather than being omitted, so a missing value is always visible as an explicit null and never as a forgotten key.

coordinates.description: [longitude, latitude], bounded to Ontario. The bounds are a correctness check, not a display hint: they catch transposed lat/lon, which is the single most common geocoding error and produces a pin in the Indian Ocean or rural China.

id.description: Stable slug. Never reused after deletion.

name_fr.description: Optional. Falls back to name at render time.

status.description: Vocabulary depends on layer; see the conditional below.

address.description: Street address as the source writes it, or null when the source gives none. Must be non-null at rooftop or street precision: those precisions claim a specific building, and the claim needs something behind it that a geocoder can be pointed at and a reader can check.

capacity_mw.description: Data centres only. Null on every other layer.

source_url.description: Mandatory provenance. Displayed in the popup.

retrieved.description: ISO date the source was last checked.

licence.description: How this record may be republished. Free text, but 'unverified' is rejected at ship time by scripts/validate.ts — the licence gate is a process rule, not a shape rule.

links.description: Named links belonging to this record — the individual academic programmes an institution offers, for instance. Null when there are none. Rendered in the popup so a reader can reach the thing itself rather than a description of it.

notes.description: Shown in the popup. Carries source conflicts verbatim.

allOf.$comment: An address-level precision has to have an address behind it. Without this, a feature could claim rooftop precision with nothing to justify it, which is the same overstatement the soft-area rendering exists to avoid.
Status vocabulary and capacity_mw are both layer-dependent.

capacity_mw.$comment: capacity_mw is meaningful only for data centres.
